candidates.name: Pott's disease
support_spans: tenderness over the thoracic spine
MRI of the spine revealed contiguous spondylitis from T6 to T10 with discitis and an epidural/paraspinal collection causing spinal cord compression
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms of chronic lower back pain and tenderness over the thoracic spine, along with the MRI findings, suggest Pott's disease.

candidates.name: Cutaneous tuberculosis
support_spans: a painful nonhealing ulcer on his right hallux
